get.description: ACTIVE authenticated host only; waiting/full room. Stable bearer invitation and deadline; no-store. Uses shared per-user invite budget, fails closed on Redis outage.

post.description: Authenticated read-only limited preview, no roster or membership effect. Malformed input is INVALID_INPUT; unknown, expired or no longer waiting/full invitations are NOT_FOUND. Shares invite budget with sharing and application join. No-store. Client retains startParam in memory through onboarding and sends parsed inviteCode with the later Socket join command; identity always comes from the authenticated session.

Opt-in room transport. Server-authenticated ACTIVE user; create requires eligible Games admission, reads require membership. Per-user Redis budgets fail closed on outage. No-store. Times are Unix milliseconds. Create retries use the same commandId and input and return the original minimal acknowledgement; GET reads current state. No invite code is exposed. Join/leave/start are application ports for future Socket adapters, not REST routes.
